capabilities: Collapse and expand all or selected canvas nodes
Toggle individual nodes by clicking their headers
Add collapse and expand commands to the canvas context menu
Set custom aliases and thumbnails shown when nodes are collapsed
extras: Not available on the community plugin market yet; installation is via BRAT or manual download from GitHub releases.
intentEvidence: A plugin for Obsidian that helps you collapse node in canvas.
problem: Obsidian's Canvas has no built-in way to collapse nodes, so large canvases stay visually cluttered.
summary: Canvas utility that collapses and expands nodes via commands, context menu, header clicks, with optional aliases and thumbnails in the collapsed state.
